attributes.name: Fan of Flames
attributes.powers: On your combat check against a bane, discard this card to add 1d6 and the Fire trait; if the bane invokes the Cold trait, add an additional 1d6. You may play this spell even if you played a spell on this check.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have the Arcane skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane 7 or Fortitude 5 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
